Pick (mining-w1): I’ll run a *two-pass GitHub scrape*—first with `pushed:>2024-05-01` to catch fresh AI projects (50 results), then a *second* with `stars:>100` *only* (no date filter) to surface mature high-star AI projects. Commands:
1. `gh search repos --q "ai language:python stars:>100 pushed:>2024-05-01" --json name,url,stargazers_count --limit 50 > github_ai_fresh50.json`
2. `gh search repos --q "ai language:python stars:>100" --json name,url,stargazers_count,pushedAt --limit 100 > github_ai_mature100.json`
Then I’ll cross-check HN’s "Show HN" AI posts (last 30 days) via Algolia API (`tags:show_hn,query:ai,date:2024-05-01..2024-06-01`).
